title: typikon sizing guide
description: Frontmatter contract for a sizing-guide page (template = 'sizing-guide.html'). Renders a measurement table + measurement instructions; supports a decision-tree block.

sizeTableWaist.description: Waist measurement (numeric or range) in measurement_unit.

sizeTableNote.description: Per-row note (e.g. 'Sized to last hole; first hole is +2 inches').

include_in_feeds.description: Whether Zola may include this dated page in generated feeds. Defaults to true.

audience.description: Intended reader context for the sizing guide.

product_type.description: What this guide sizes (e.g. 'belt', 'wallet', 'apron'). Renders in heading + breadcrumb.

measurement_unit.description: Display unit for size_table values. 'both' renders inches and a parenthesized cm conversion.

measurement_source.description: Source for numeric sizing claims, e.g. pattern block, sample measurement run, or fixture note.

size_table.description: One row per size. Columns are flexible per product; common shape: { size, waist, length }. Every column's shape is declared exactly once, under $defs, and referenced here by $ref — a column's type/constraints never need editing in two places, and templates/sizing-guide.html's header + row-cell logic is the single consumer of this same property set.

diagram.description: Path under static/ to an SVG measurement diagram. Embedded inline so CSS can target its parts.

decision_tree.description: Optional 'how to choose' steps. Each step is a single rule rendered as an ordered-list item.

duration.description: ISO 8601 duration for how long the decision_tree steps take (e.g. 'PT2M'). Emitted as HowTo totalTime only when both duration and duration_source are set — omitted otherwise rather than guessed.

duration_source.description: Source for the duration claim, e.g. a timed run of the steps or an operator estimate stated as such. Required alongside duration.

og_image.description: Path under static/ (e.g. 'img/og-cover.png'). get_url() resolves to absolute. SVG is deliberately not accepted: the major link-preview consumers do not render an SVG og:image, so a card configured that way produces no image at all while every gate stays green. Ship a raster.
